nodes.label: Partitioning Large Tables by Range
nodes.source_location: ## Partition Large Tables for Better Performance
nodes.rationale: Beyond ~100M rows, both queries and maintenance touch everything: VACUUM takes hours and locks, DELETE of old data is unbearable. Range partitioning by time enables partition pruning and turns data expiry into an instant DROP TABLE.

edges.source_location: vacuum events;  -- Takes hours, locks table
